en-US.title: Menivor: AI Video Maker
en-US.shortDescription: Type an idea or paste a link. Get a captioned vertical video with voice.
en-US.fullDescription:
Menivor turns an idea into a finished vertical video. Type a topic, paste a link or bring your own footage, and Menivor writes the hook, adds a voice, cuts b-roll and burns in word-by-word captions.

FROM A PROMPT OR A LINK
Describe what the video is about, or paste a product page or article. Menivor drafts three different hooks and renders each as its own 9:16 reel, so you can watch them side by side and keep the best one.

YOUR OWN FOOTAGE
Import a clip or screen recording from your library, trim it, and Menivor narrates and captions it. Long recordings can be cut into several short clips, each scored on how strong its opening is.

EDIT ON A TIMELINE
Reorder and trim segments, change speed, add text overlays and export the result as a new reel.

CAPTIONS THAT HOLD ATTENTION
Choose a caption style, use bold one or two word punch captions, check safe zones so nothing hides under app buttons, and get a hook score before you post.

VOICE, PRESENTER AND LANGUAGES
Pick a narrator voice or record a short sample to create your own. Take a selfie to make an on-screen presenter. Dub a finished video into another language with subtitle files.

B-ROLL AND BRAND
Generate b-roll clips for any scene, set a brand watermark, and start from templates when you want a proven structure.

TRACK EVERY RENDER
The Reels tab shows each video as it moves through script, voice, captions and compose, and tells you when it is ready to save or share.

CREDITS AND MENIVOR PRO
Renders use credits. Credit packs and Menivor Pro are sold through Google Play at the price shown in the app. Failed renders are refunded automatically and credits do not expire. Menivor Pro is an auto-renewing subscription that unlocks exporting and saving your reels; cancel anytime in your Google Play subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
An account is needed so your videos follow you across devices. You can export your data or delete your account at any time from Account > Privacy and data.
